title: ‘The State of Us’ Directors on Platforming Positive Masculinity and Making a Gut-Wrenching British Indie: “You Have to Beg, Borrow and Steal”
summary: Ollie Gardner and Jake Harvey come to Edinburgh, Callum Scott Howells and Samuel Bottomley in tow, with a Pippa Cross-backed movie about the unspoken intimacy of male friendship: "We [need to] start showing young men that you can love another man and it can be platonic and a really beautiful thing."
